Name: CHARACTER_INIT_PARAM
Description: Starting loadouts for player characters: the starting classes (3000+), keepsakes (2400–2499), character-creation face presets (3100+) and the NPC players (invaders, summons and NPC phantoms). A row sets attributes, equipment, inventory, spells, gestures, flasks and, for NPC players, face, voice and body type.

Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0.

Fields.Description: FaceParam row applied as the character's face. 0 or -1 keeps the current face: the class rows use -1, so the face made in character creation stays. The face preset rows (3100+) point to their own FaceParam rows.

Fields.Name: NPC Player - Type
Fields.Description: Sets the character type an NPC player is spawned as: 0 is the default, 1–3 pick other types. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: NPC Player - Draw Type
Fields.Description: Draw type for a character spawned from this row, used instead of the one it would otherwise get. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Body Type
Fields.Description: Body type: 1 = Body Type A, 0 = Body Type B. Decides which armor models and part masks apply. Retail: 1 on the classes; 0 on the Body Type B face presets and about 490 NPC player rows.

Fields.Name: Covenant
Fields.Description: Covenant the character starts in (0: none). Elden Ring has no covenants; retail always 0.

Fields.Name: Is Sync Target
Fields.Description: Marks the character as a network send/receive target (for copied NPC players). Set on 61 retail rows, such as 20001.
Padding.
